enonce.texte:
Match the English festival names with their French translations.

  • 1. Christmas
  • 2. Eid
  • 3. New Year
  • 4. Wedding
  • 5. Birthday

Translations: A. Mariage B. Noël C. Nouvel An D. Anniversaire E. Aïd

questions.texte: Match each English word with its correct French translation.

enonce.texte: Read each description and identify the festival or celebration.

questions.texte: This festival is celebrated on December 25th. People give gifts and decorate a tree.
This celebration marks the beginning of the year. People often make resolutions.
This is a religious festival celebrated by Muslims at the end of Ramadan.
This celebration happens when two people get married. There is often a party and a cake.

enonce.texte: Describe how Christmas is celebrated in Cameroon. Write at least 5 sentences. Include information about decorations, food, and activities.

questions.reponse: In Cameroon, Christmas is a big celebration. People decorate their homes and churches with lights and stars. Families come together to share a special meal. Many people go to church on Christmas Eve. Children sing songs and dance. People give gifts to their loved ones. It is a happy time for everyone.

intitule: Using 'Used To' to Talk About Past Habits

enonce.texte: Complete the sentences with the correct form of 'used to' or the past simple.

questions.texte: When I was a child, I _______ (celebrate) my birthday with a big party every year.
My grandmother _______ (live) in the village. Now she lives in the city.
We _______ (not / have) a big celebration for New Year, but now we do.
_______ you _______ (go) to church every Sunday when you were young?

enonce.texte:
Write a short paragraph (5-7 sentences) about your favourite celebration. Answer these questions:

  • What is the celebration?
  • When does it happen?
  • What do you do during this celebration?
  • Why do you like it?

questions.reponse: My favourite celebration is New Year. It happens on January 1st. We stay awake until midnight to watch the fireworks. My family cooks a big meal and we dance and sing. I love this celebration because it is a time for new beginnings and we are all together. It makes me feel happy and excited for the year ahead.

enonce.texte:
Read the text and answer the questions.

In Cameroon, Christmas is a very important celebration. Families come together to share a meal. Many people go to church and sing carols. In the USA, Christmas is also celebrated, but people often exchange gifts and decorate a big tree. In Nigeria, people celebrate Eid with prayers and special food.

questions.texte: How is Christmas celebrated in Cameroon?
questions.reponse: Families come together to share a meal. Many people go to church and sing carols.

questions.texte: How is Christmas celebrated in the USA?
questions.reponse: People exchange gifts and decorate a big tree.

questions.texte: How is Eid celebrated in Nigeria?
questions.reponse: People celebrate Eid with prayers and special food.

enonce.texte: Write a short essay (150-200 words) describing how you used to celebrate a certain festival when you were a child, and how you celebrate it now. Use 'used to' and the present simple correctly.

questions.texte: Write about a festival you celebrated differently in the past.
questions.reponse: When I was a child, I used to celebrate Christmas at my grandmother's house in the village. We used to wake up early and go to church. After church, we used to eat a big meal together. I used to receive many gifts from my relatives. Now, I live in the city and I celebrate Christmas with my friends. We don't go to church as often, but we still have a big dinner and exchange gifts. I still feel happy during this time, but I miss the old days. It is different now, but I enjoy it.
